gen_stay_01.t: Stay. Good boy. Stay right there.

gen_stay_03.t: Sit. Stay. Look at me. Good.

gen_drop_01.t: Drop it. Drop it. Thank you.

gen_drop_02.t: Pickles, drop it. That is not food.

gen_drop_03.t: Give it. Give it here. Good boy.

gen_wrong_01.t: Pickles. No. That is not yours.

gen_wrong_02.t: Pickles, that's a live wire. Do not lick that.

gen_wrong_04.t: Pickles, why do you have that.

gen_miracle_02.t: He's fine. Why is he fine?

gen_miracle_03.t: That should have killed him. I'm not going to question it.

gen_haz_04.t: I'm going to stand over here instead.

gen_haz_05.t: Everything is a hazard. Everything is a hazard.

gen_haz_06.t: Nothing suspicious. Nothing suspicious at all.

gen_haz_07.t: If that falls, I'm not standing here.

gen_save_01.t: I did it. I did it?

gen_fail_02.t: That's not what I meant. That's not what I meant!

gen_fail_03.t: Well. That's one way to do it.

gen_pet_02.t: You're an indestructible boy, aren't you.

gen_pet_03.t: Belly's safe. It's a safe belly.

gen_pet_04.t: I would do anything for you, you know that.

gen_pet_05.t: Okay. Okay. Enough. You've had enough. You haven't had enough.

gen_nope_02.t: No. I'm not touching that. I've learned.

gen_heavy_01.t: That's heavy. I'm not built for that.

gen_notyet_01.t: Not yet. I should look around first.

gen_dogbark_thanks.t: Thank you. Yes. I heard you.

ch1_arrive_01.t: Centennial Transit Center. Nobody calls it that. Everybody calls it Terminus Station.

ch1_arrive_02.t: "The last stop you'll ever need." That is a threat.

ch1_arrive_03.t: Pickles. Do not eat anything off the floor. It's brand new. It hasn't had time to get disgusting yet.

ch1_arrive_04.t: Okay. Platform four. First day. Nothing is going to happen.

ch1_pa_01.t: The eight fourteen to Riverside will depart from platform four.

ch1_pa_02.t: Please keep your belongings with you at all times.

ch1_pa_03.t: Welcome to Centennial Transit Center. The last stop you'll ever need.

ch1_pa_04.t: Escalator maintenance is scheduled for later this month. Please use caution.

ch1_pa_05.t: Please do not feed the pigeons. The pigeons are statues.

ch1_pa_06.t: Passengers are reminded that pets must remain on a leash. Thank you.

ch1_ticket_02.t: I don't have exact fare. I have a card. Please accept the card.

ch1_ticket_04.t: It's a brand new machine. It's been open four days.

ch1_ticket_05.t: Thank you for choosing Centennial Transit. Your journey ends here.

ch1_ticket_06.t: It says my journey ends here. That's just the end of the printout. Right.

ch1_ticket_repeat.t: I have the ticket. I should go find the platform.

ch1_kid_01.t: Excuse me! Is your dog nice?

ch1_kid_02.t: He's mostly nice. He's very committed to being nice.

ch1_kid_03.t: My ball rolled under the bench. Can he get it?

ch1_kid_05.t: Thank you! Thank you! You can have my sticker!

ch1_kid_06.t: "Junior Safety Inspector." Thanks. I'll take it under advisement.

ch1_kid_wait_01.t: It's under the bench! The bench right there!

ch1_kid_wait_02.t: Pickles can do it. I know he can.

ch1_kid_hint.t: Pickles, fetch. I have to say it out loud, apparently.

ch1_scaffold_01.t: "Mind your head." Good advice. I'm minding it.

ch1_barrier_01.t: Temporary barrier. It's the only thing between me and platform four.

ch1_barrier_02.t: It's a very short barrier. I can do this.

ch1_brenda_01.t: Hey, hey! Don't mind me, I'm doing a quick walkthrough of the new station! Wave at the camera!

ch1_brenda_03.t: Love that energy. Okay, so, structural integrity: looks solid. That sculpture? Hangs from six cables. Six! I counted. They're rated way over its weight. Which is great, unless they aren't.

ch1_brenda_04.t: Why would you say "unless they aren't"?

ch1_brenda_repeat_01.t: Is that a dog? Can the dog be in the video? Say yes.

ch1_brenda_repeat_02.t: Don't look at the lens. Look meaningfully.

ch1_dale_01.t: You feel it too, don't you. This place opened four days ago and it already has a slogan. Nobody's slogan is that honest. Think about that.

ch1_dale_repeat_01.t: They put the escalators in a line. In a LINE, man.

ch1_dale_repeat_02.t: Do not trust the pigeon. The pigeon is a statue. What does that tell you.

ch1_tiffany_03.t: No, it's fine, I'm holding space. I'm Tiffany Vale, Aligned Living? We're doing a pop-up this weekend. You look like you have a lot of stored tension.

ch1_tiffany_04.t: I have a dog and a first day.

ch1_tiffany_repeat_01.t: Don't jostle the smoothie. It's a cold-pressed manifestation.

ch1_tiffany_repeat_02.t: I've never been in danger. I've done the work.

ch1_gus_04.t: You brought a wrench to a train station?

ch1_gus_05.t: Forty-one years. Never leave the house without a wrench.

ch1_gus_repeat_01.t: Exit's behind you. Always know where the exit is.

ch1_ml_01.t: That's the third time you've made us miss a train.

ch1_ml_02.t: The first one doesn't count! The clock was wrong!

ch1_ml_03.t: It was a train station clock, Luis!

ch1_ml_05.t: Okay. I'll leave you to it.

ch1_ml_repeat_02.t: I'm not wrong! Tell him I'm not wrong!

ch1_mills_01.t: Morning. Dogs on a leash, please. Pilot program. Don't make me regret it.

ch1_mills_03.t: That's what everybody says right before something gets peed on.

ch1_insp_sculpture.t: Six cables. That's a lot of cables to trust.

ch1_insp_escalator.t: An escalator. Steps that move on their own. Who thought of this.

ch1_insp_cart.t: Baggage cart. The brake's on. Probably.

ch1_insp_scrub.t: A little robot floor cleaner. It looks so proud.

ch1_insp_smoothie.t: Juice Junction. A place where things get blended. Nothing bad about that.

ch1_insp_sign.t: Wet floor sign. Somebody cares about the floor.

ch1_insp_panel.t: Electrical panel. I'd rather not know.

ch1_insp_skylink.t: The SkyLink. A train on a shelf.

ch1_insp_ceiling.t: That is a lot of ceiling.

ch1_insp_pigeon.t: A pigeon statue. Very lifelike. Suspiciously lifelike.

ch1_insp_clock.t: A decorative clock. It says ten past never.

ch1_insp_handle.t: A red emergency handle. In case of emergency, pull. Not an emergency. Yet.

ch1_insp_train.t: The eight fourteen. It's big. It's on time. I love that for us.

ch1_insp_luggage.t: Somebody's suitcase. Somebody trusts the floor.

ch1_insp_map.t: You are here. That's comforting, honestly.

ch1_snap_01.t: Oh no. Oh no no no.

ch1_snap_02.t: Everybody out! Everybody get out of here!

ch1_snap_03.t: I saw it. I saw all of it. The cup. The cart. The ceiling.

ch1_panic_hint.t: I need to get people out. Now.

ch1_panic_grabcup_reply.t: Excuse me?! That was a thirty-two dollar manifestation!

ch1_panic_alarm_pa.t: Fire alarm activated. Please proceed to the nearest exit.

ch1_panic_cart.t: Nobody touch the cart! Nobody go near the cart!

ch1_warn_brenda_01.t: You have to leave. Now. The sculpture, the escalator, all of it.

ch1_warn_brenda_02.t: Is this a bit? Tell me it's a bit.

ch1_warn_dale_01.t: Something's going to happen here. In the next few minutes.

ch1_warn_dale_02.t: I KNEW it. I knew it! What is it? The tower? I'll get my sign.

ch1_warn_tiffany_01.t: Ma'am, you need to leave the building.

ch1_warn_tiffany_02.t: I'm not comfortable with your energy. I'm going to hold that boundary. Outside.

ch1_warn_gus_01.t: Sir, we need to leave the station.

ch1_warn_gus_03.t: I saw a hazard. A lot of hazards.

ch1_warn_ml_01.t: You two need to leave. The station's going to collapse!

ch1_warn_ml_06.t: Fine. But I'm winning this argument outside.

ch1_mills_arrest_01.t: Sir! Sir! What do you think you're doing?

ch1_mills_arrest_02.t: Everyone has to get out! It's going to fall!

ch1_mills_arrest_05.t: Out. Now. You and the dog.

ch1_mills_arrest_07.t: I'll listen from the parking lot. Move.

ch1_exit_01.t: Everybody, exit the building. Calmly. Calmly! Not like that.

ch1_exit_03.t: Wait, wait, I'm getting all this!

ch1_out_01.t: Stay here. Don't move. I'm going to have a lot of paperwork about you.

ch1_out_03.t: That was extremely rude. I'm going to leave a review.

ch1_out_04.t: Nothing's happening. Bummer. I mean, great! Great. Nothing's happening.

ch1_after_05.t: Please tell me somebody got that.

ch2_wake_02.t: Eleven days since the station. Ninety-one hours since I slept in a bed.

ch2_wake_03.t: Pickles is fine. Pickles is asleep. Pickles is the only one of us doing this correctly.

ch2_phone_01.t: The group chat has been busy.

ch2_phone_02.t: It's called "Station Survivors, Do Not Leave." Brenda made it. I can't leave it. It says so.

ch2_vm_brenda.t: Hey survivors! Brenda here. Just wanted to say, the group chat is officially open, please don't mute it. Also, the station footage has four million views? So, thank you, I guess. Weird energy. Anyway, hardware store, nine tonight. I need a sidekick. Bring the dog!

ch2_vm_dale.t: Okay, so I cross-referenced the escalator maintenance logs with the sculpture's installation date, and here's what I found. Nothing! Which is exactly what they want me to find! Eddie, you predicted it. You're either a plant or a prophet. I need to know which.

ch2_vm_tiffany.t: Hi, all. Sending love and light. Also, please stop tagging me in the collapse video, my brand is about renewal. Eddie, I've forgiven you. It's a whole process.

ch2_vm_marco.t: We're fine. Luis stood in the fire.

ch2_vm_luis.t: It wasn't a fire! It was a small, intense warmth!

ch2_vm_mills.t: Mercer. It's Mills. The detective is asking again about the alarm. I told them what I saw. I'm not sure what I saw. Call me.

ch2_insp_outlet.t: I covered all the outlets. Nothing gets in the outlets.

ch2_insp_corners.t: Foam corners. Every sharp edge in this apartment now wears a little foam hat.

ch2_insp_oven.t: Oven mitts on the knobs. It's not a bad system.

ch2_insp_extinguisher.t: Four fire extinguishers. One is for the other three.

ch2_insp_wall.t: The wall. It's a lot of string.

ch2_insp_fridge.t: Pickles' feeding schedule, color coded. I did that at three in the morning.

ch2_insp_window.t: Third floor. Fine. It's a very reasonable fall height, for no reason at all.

ch2_insp_lamp.t: Lamp. Rated for a hundred watts. I use a forty.

ch2_insp_tv.t: The TV. It's been on the news for eleven days. The news has not gotten better.

ch2_insp_couch.t: The couch. I've been sleeping here since I put a helmet on the bed.

ch2_insp_desk.t: Notebook. Pen. A backup pen. A backup for the backup.

ch2_insp_vest.t: Reflective vest for Pickles. Helmet for Pickles. He does not enjoy the helmet.

ch2_insp_kettle.t: I unplug the kettle every time. Every time. Even while it's boiling.

ch2_insp_door.t: Four locks. A chain. A very small extra chain.

ch2_insp_shelf.t: Bolted to the wall. Twice. Nobody's shelf is getting me.

ch2_insp_rug.t: Tape on the rug edges. Nobody's tripping in this apartment. Except me.

ch2_insp_bed.t: The bed. The helmet's on it. I don't want to talk about it.

ch2_insp_clippings.t: Newspaper clippings. Escalator accidents. Elevators. Coincidences. Everything is a coincidence until it isn't.

ch2_bowl_01.t: Breakfast. Eat slowly. Chew. Please don't choke.

ch2_bowl_02.t: I have made you food seventeen times today. You are not underfed.

ch2_tv_01.t: In local news, the death toll from the Centennial Transit Center collapse has been revised to eleven. Officials say early evacuations, reportedly prompted by a man and his dog, saved dozens.

ch2_tv_02.t: And in a related and, frankly, unusual development, Kevin Lindqvist, a survivor of the collapse, was killed yesterday when an oversized novelty check fell from a parade float.

ch2_tv_03.t: Organizers say the check was for charity. It was for eleven thousand dollars.

ch2_tv_05.t: Not the ceiling. Not the escalator. A novelty check.

ch2_tv_06.t: That's not how any of this is supposed to work.

ch2_tv_07.t: ...Any of this. What am I even saying.

ch2_call_graves_01.t: Mister Mercer. Doctor Mortimer Graves. County coroner's office. We have not met.

ch2_call_graves_02.t: That is the correct answer. Most people say yes, and then ask whether I am the man from television.

ch2_call_graves_04.t: Kevin Lindqvist was on your list.

ch2_call_graves_05.t: You do now. You were at the station. You saw an order. Whatever you saw, it was in order.

ch2_call_graves_06.t: I do not. But it is a very good line, and I have been saving it.

ch2_call_graves_07.t: Write it down, Mister Mercer. Who. In what order. Death is a stickler for order.

ch2_call_graves_08.t: It is a sandwich-adjacent opinion. Forgive me. I am mid-sandwich.

ch2_seq_01.t: Okay. The station. What did I see. In order.

ch2_seq_02.t: Kevin. That's done. Brenda. She was by the sculpture. The cables went, and I think she was next.

ch2_seq_03.t: Tiffany. Then Marco and Luis, probably together. Dale. Mills.

ch2_seq_06.t: Which means I have to get to Brenda first.

ch2_seq_07.t: I'm going to regret writing this down.

ch2_leave_01.t: Pickles. Come on. We're going to a hardware store.

ch2_leave_02.t: It's fine. It's a hardware store. What's the worst that could happen. Don't answer that.

ch2_hint_seq.t: I should write down what I remember. The notebook's on the desk.

ch2_hint_notyet.t: I'm not going anywhere until I figure out the order.

ch2_pet_hint.t: Sorry, buddy. Sorry. I'm here. I'm here.
